title: Adoption
definition: Adoption is God's gracious act of receiving believers into His family as His children through Jesus Christ.
summary: Adoption means believers are brought into God's family and given the privileges of sons and daughters.
christFocus: Through Christ, believers receive the Spirit of adoption and are welcomed by God as beloved children.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Adoption is one of the great blessings of salvation. God does not only forgive sinners; He brings them into His family. Believers are given a new identity, new access, new inheritance, and a new relationship with the Father.

This adoption comes through Christ. The eternal Son makes redeemed sinners sons and daughters by grace. The Spirit bears witness that believers belong to God.

Adoption gives security and belonging. Christians do not approach God as strangers trying to earn a place, but as children welcomed through Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people live with rejection, abandonment, shame, or the feeling that they do not belong. Adoption matters because it declares that in Christ, believers are not spiritual orphans but beloved children of God.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Pray to God as Father through Christ. Let your identity as God's child shape your confidence, obedience, endurance, and love for others in the family of God.
